classification.difficultyReason: Read marked points on coordinate grids and determine their signed vertical and horizontal changes, including across an axis, before calculating gradient.

content.prompt: Find the gradient of these lines. Remember to check positive or negative.

spec.description: Unit coordinate grid with two-ended axes and a rising line through two marked points; only the upper point is coordinate-labelled.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-3..4, y=-2..4, step 1. Line y=x+1. Marked points (-1,0) and (2,3). Printed x ticks -2,-1,1,2,3; printed y ticks -1,1,2,3.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph and coordinate label remain visible; gradient answer is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Rise $=3$, run $=3$. The line slopes upwards from left to right.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{3}{3}\\m&=1\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unit coordinate grid with a rising line and two marked points; only (3,3) is coordinate-labelled.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-2..5, y=-2..4, step 1. Line y=4x/3-1. Marked points (0,-1) and (3,3). Printed x ticks -1,1,2,3,4; printed y ticks -1,1,2,3.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph givens remain visible; gradient answer is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Rise $=4$, run $=3$. The line slopes upwards from left to right.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{4}{3}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Descending line with arrows at both ends and two marked intercepts on a unit coordinate grid.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-2..5, y=-2..4, step 1. Line y=2-2x/3. Marked points (0,2) and (3,0), without coordinate labels. Printed x ticks -1,1,2,3,4; printed y ticks -1,1,2,3.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph givens remain visible; gradient answer is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Rise $=-2$, run $=3$. The line slopes downwards from left to right.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{-2}{3}\\m&=-\frac{2}{3}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Rising line on a unit coordinate grid with marked points (-2,3) and (0,4); only (-2,3) is coordinate-labelled.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-4..2, y=-1..5, step 1. Line y=x/2+4. Printed x ticks -3,-2,-1,0,1; printed y ticks 1,2,3,4.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph givens remain visible; gradient answer is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Rise $=1$, run $=2$. The line slopes upwards from left to right.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Steep descending line with two marked intercepts and arrows at both ends on a unit coordinate grid.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-3..2, y=-4..2, step 1. Line y=-2x-2. Marked points (-1,0) and (0,-2), without coordinate labels. Printed x ticks -2,-1,1; printed y ticks 1,-1,-2,-3.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph givens remain visible; gradient answer is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Rise $=-2$, run $=1$. The line slopes downwards from left to right.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{-2}{1}\\m&=-2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Shallow descending line with marked points (0,-2) and (4,-3); only (4,-3) is coordinate-labelled.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-2..6, y=-4..2, step 1. Line y=-x/4-2. Printed x ticks -1,1,2,3,4,5; printed y ticks 1,-1,-2,-3.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph givens remain visible; gradient answer is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Rise $=-1$, run $=4$. The line slopes downwards from left to right.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}\\m&=\frac{-1}{4}\\m&=-\frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}$$
